verdict.rationale: Whether a software product publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows ComplyAdvantage source code or any open license. The downloadable OpenAPI schema and Postman collection describe the API; they are not product source code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
